articles.summary: Enpro Inc. (NYSE: NPO) will release financial results for the fourth quarter and year ended December 31, 2025, on Wednesday, February 18, at 6:30 a.m. Eastern Time. articles.summary: Enpro Inc. (NYSE: NPO) today declared a quarterly dividend of $0.32 per share, a 3.2% increase from the previous $0.31 per share quarterly dividend. Since initiating a dividend in 2015, the company has increased its quarterly payout annually. “We are pleased to increase our dividend again for the eleventh consecutive year.
